text:
Matt Boldy is doing nearly everything right except scoring. He has 81 shots and 10.6 expected goals (the quality of his chances), but only seven goals, shooting 8.6%. Goals tend to follow chances like that, which is why our numbers call him due rather than cold.

The line around him is humming. Minnesota takes 62% of expected goals at 5-on-5 when Boldy plays, nearly 13 points better than when he sits, and his assists kept a point streak alive into November. "Can't say it enough, I just feel like we can tilt the ice when they're out there," Quinn Hughes said of the Kaprizov, Boldy and Joel Eriksson Ek line, as posted by Heather Rule of NHL.com.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 6.5 scoring chances per 60 from the slot last season, 84th percentile, and Evolving-Hockey ranked him 32nd of 401 forwards in wins above replacement. The shot will come. Our range has him at 30 to 49 goals by April.
headline: Matt Boldy is getting the looks, not the goals
